### Brief Solutions

- **[id 140]**: Semi-automatic cars = $20 - 12 - 4 = 4$. Percentage = $(4 / 20) \times 100 = 20\%$.
- **[id 141]**: Let queens be $Q$. Baby bees $B = 2Q$, worker bees $W = 4Q$. Total bees = $7Q = 700 \implies Q = 100$. Worker bees = $4 \times 100 = 400$.
- **[id 142]**: Total hours in a week = $2 \times 7 = 14$ hours. Earnings = $14 \times \$10 = \$140$.
- **[id 143]**: Food items = $\$2 + \$3 = \$5$. Nonfood items = $\$3 + \$3 + \$4 = \$10$. Tax on nonfood = $10\% \times \$10 = \$1$. Total cost = $\$5 + \$10 + \$1 = \$16$.
- **[id 144]**: Total clients = $3 + 5 = 8$. Expense per client = $(2 \times \$2) + \$5 = \$9$. Total expenses = $8 \times \$9 = \$72$. Profit = $\$92 - \$72 = \$20$.
- **[id 145]**: Pineapples per harvest = $10 \times 100 = 1000$. Number of harvests per year = $12 / 3 = 4$. Total pineapples = $1000 \times 4 = 4000$.
- **[id 146]**: First set = $500$. Second set = $3 \times 500 = 1500$. Third set = $500 / 4 = 125$. Total blocks = $500 + 1500 + 125 = 2125$.
- **[id 147]**: First 6 hours: 30 bees leave. Next 6 hours: 15 return (15 outside). Next 6 hours: $2 \times 30 = 60$ leave ($15 + 60 = 75$ outside). Last 6 hours: all remaining 75 return.
- **[id 148]**: Cost of tickets = $\$12 + \$10 = \$22$. Amount given = $\$22 + \$8 = \$30$.
- **[id 149]**: Dorothy has $12 / 3 = 4$ friends. James has $4 \times 4 = 16$ friends.
